articles.title: Tyre Burst Turns Deadly: Bolero Flips on Mysore–Bengaluru Highway, Disaster Averted
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major accident was narrowly averted after a Mahindra Bolero lost control and overturned on the Mysore–Bengaluru highway following a sudden front tyre burst. According to eyewitnesses, the incident unfolded within seconds.

body.html:
A major accident was narrowly averted after a Mahindra Bolero lost control and overturned on the Mysore–Bengaluru highway following a sudden front tyre burst.

According to eyewitnesses, the incident unfolded within seconds. What began as a routine drive turned into a dangerous situation as the vehicle swerved uncontrollably after the tyre burst and flipped in the middle of the road.

Despite the severity of the crash, no injuries were reported.

Other motorists on the highway reacted swiftly, managing to avoid a collision and preventing further damage or casualties.

The incident highlights the unpredictable risks associated with road travel. Experts have stressed the importance of regular vehicle maintenance, staying alert while driving, and maintaining a safe distance from other vehicles—particularly at high speeds.

articles.title: Wife, Lover Plot Ex-Army Man’s Murder; Tried Secret Cremation to Hide Crime
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 45-year-old retired Army man was allegedly strangled to death in Rajasthan’s Kota city in a conspiracy hatched by his wife along with her lover and his associate, police said on Saturday.

body.html:
A 45-year-old retired Army man was allegedly strangled to death in Rajasthan’s Kota city in a conspiracy hatched by his wife along with her lover and his associate, police said on Saturday.

The incident took place in the Avani Road area under the RK Puram police station limits on the intervening night of Thursday and Friday.

The deceased, Manoj Kumar Sharma, a native of Kishangarh in Ajmer, had been residing in Kota with his family for several years. After retiring from the Indian Army five years ago, he was working as a clerk in the Ajmer electricity department.

According to police, the accused were preparing to conduct Sharma’s last rites on Friday morning without informing his parents, who live in Kishangarh. However, neighbours grew suspicious and alerted the family.

Sharma’s parents reached Kota on Friday afternoon, halted the cremation, and filed a complaint against his wife Deepika (40), her alleged lover Devesh, and his friend Vishnu.

During examination, police found strangulation marks on the body, indicating foul play. Circle Inspector Sidharth Shrivastav stated that initial investigations revealed Deepika was in a relationship with Devesh, who frequently visited the house in Sharma’s absence.

On Thursday night, Sharma, Devesh and Vishnu allegedly consumed alcohol together, during which a dispute broke out. Devesh, along with Vishnu, allegedly strangled Sharma to death in the presence of Deepika.

At the time of the incident, the couple’s two children—a 12-year-old daughter and a 14-year-old son—were reportedly asleep in an upstairs room.

Based on a complaint by Sharma’s father, police have registered a case of murder and criminal conspiracy against the three accused. Two of them have been arrested, while Devesh remains absconding. Police teams have been formed to trace him.

Family members alleged that relations between Sharma and his wife had been strained for years and claimed she had previously assaulted him.

Further investigation is underway.

#Kota #Rajasthan #MurderCase #BreakingNews #CrimeNews

articles.title: Viral Video Sparks Outrage: Tribal Youth Beaten with Hockey Stick at NCL Plant in MP
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing video showing the alleged assault of a tribal youth has surfaced from the Nigahi Coal Handling Plant (CHP) area of Northern Coalfields Limited (NCL) in Singrauli district, triggering widespread outrage.

body.html:
A disturbing video showing the alleged assault of a tribal youth has surfaced from the Nigahi Coal Handling Plant (CHP) area of Northern Coalfields Limited (NCL) in Singrauli district, triggering widespread outrage.

The video, which is reportedly around two months old but surfaced recently, shows a security in-charge allegedly beating Anne Lal Baig, a member of the Baiga tribal community, with a hockey stick inside the Nigahi CHP premises.

According to reports, Anne Lal Baig had entered the plant area along with his wife and was allegedly picking up metal items when security personnel intervened. It is claimed that he was under the influence of alcohol and refused to comply, following which he was assaulted.

Taking cognisance of the viral video, Navanagar Police have registered a case against the accused security in-charge. Station in-charge Anil Patel stated that action has been initiated based on the footage, adding that immediate steps would have been taken had a complaint been filed earlier.

Police have launched a search for the victim and are identifying all those involved in the incident. The case is also being probed under relevant legal provisions, including sections related to assault and the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act.

The incident has sparked anger among local residents and the tribal community, with demands for strict action against those responsible. Activists have also raised concerns over the safety and treatment of vulnerable tribal groups near industrial zones.

Authorities said further investigation is underway and appropriate legal action will be taken based on findings.

#Singrauli #MadhyaPradesh #TribalRights #ViralVideo #BreakingNews

articles.title: Giant Banner Turns Dangerous in Tiruppur—Flies Off in Strong Winds, Knocks Down Biker
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking incident, strong winds in Tamil Nadu’s Tiruppur district caused a roadside banner to collapse, injuring a two-wheeler rider on a busy stretch. The incident occurred on Friday evening along the Coimbatore–Palladam Road near Lakshmi Mills.

body.html:
In a shocking incident, strong winds in Tamil Nadu’s Tiruppur district caused a roadside banner to collapse, injuring a two-wheeler rider on a busy stretch.

The incident occurred on Friday evening along the Coimbatore–Palladam Road near Lakshmi Mills. According to reports, gusty winds swept through the area, dislodging a large banner installed close to the roadside.

Eyewitnesses said the banner could not withstand the sudden wind pressure and tore apart. A portion of it flew onto the road and struck a passing biker, causing him to lose balance and fall. The rider sustained injuries, though his exact condition is not immediately known.

A video of the incident has surfaced online and is being widely shared. The footage shows the banner flapping violently before collapsing onto the road, followed by the biker’s fall.

The incident has raised concerns over the safety of large banners and hoardings placed along busy roads, particularly during adverse weather conditions. Locals have demanded stricter monitoring and safety checks to prevent such accidents.

#TamilNadu #Tiruppur #BreakingNews #RoadAccident #ViralVideo

articles.title: Bengaluru Rains Turn Fatal: Student Electrocuted by Live Wire Near Commercial Street
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A student died of electrocution during heavy rains in Bengaluru on Wednesday evening, raising serious concerns over public safety and infrastructure during extreme weather conditions. The deceased has been identified as Syed Sufiyan, a resident of Yarab Nagar in KG Halli.

body.html:
A student died of electrocution during heavy rains in Bengaluru on Wednesday evening, raising serious concerns over public safety and infrastructure during extreme weather conditions.

The deceased has been identified as Syed Sufiyan, a resident of Yarab Nagar in KG Halli. According to reports, he had recently passed his First PUC examination and had gone to Commercial Street to purchase clothes.

As heavy rain lashed the area, a live electric wire is suspected to have snapped and fallen across a stretch of nearly 50 metres. While attempting to park his motorcycle amid the downpour, Sufiyan reportedly came into contact with the live wire and was electrocuted on the spot.

Family members alleged that electricity had leaked from a nearby pole, leading to the fatal incident.

Eyewitnesses said Sufiyan’s mother, Ume Salma, who was present at the scene, collapsed after witnessing the tragedy. Locals rushed both to a nearby hospital, where doctors declared Sufiyan dead.

The body has been shifted to Bowring Hospital for post-mortem examination.

Shivajinagar Police have registered a case and launched an investigation to ascertain the exact cause of the electrical leak. Officials are also examining whether negligence or infrastructure failure contributed to the incident.

#Bengaluru #Electrocution #BreakingNews #RainAlert #Public

articles.title: Bargi Dam Tragedy: Cruise Capsizes in Storm, 10 Dead; Video Shows Passengers Unaware, No Life Jacket
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A chilling video recorded moments before a cruise boat capsized at Bargi Dam on the Narmada River near Jabalpur has gone viral, showing tourists enjoying cool weather and strong winds—unaware of the impending disaster.

body.html:
A chilling video recorded moments before a cruise boat capsized at Bargi Dam on the Narmada River near Jabalpur has gone viral, showing tourists enjoying cool weather and strong winds—unaware of the impending disaster.

The incident occurred on Thursday evening when a sudden storm with wind speeds of 60–70 kmph hit the area, creating turbulent conditions. The vessel, identified as Narmada Queen and operated by the Madhya Pradesh Tourism Department, was carrying around 43 passengers, including crew members, when it lost balance and overturned mid-reservoir.

According to officials, the death toll has risen to 10, including a child, while 28 passengers have been rescued and at least three remain missing. Rescue operations involving the Army, National Disaster Response Force (NDRF), and State Disaster Response Force (SDRF) are ongoing, though low visibility has hampered efforts.

The viral footage shows that passengers were not wearing life jackets before the incident. Survivors alleged that safety gear was distributed only after the boat began sinking, causing panic. Some passengers managed to wear life jackets later, which reportedly helped save several lives.

Eyewitnesses said the weather deteriorated rapidly, with strong winds making the water choppy. Several passengers had warned the crew and requested to turn back, but their concerns were allegedly ignored. Locals and workers later assisted in rescue efforts using ropes.

Authorities suspect the vessel capsized due to high-velocity winds destabilising it. Questions have also been raised over alleged safety lapses, including sailing despite weather alerts, delayed distribution of life jackets, and possible overcrowding.

Following the tragedy, the Madhya Pradesh government has suspended similar cruise operations and initiated a high-level inquiry. Action has been taken against staff, including termination and suspension of those responsible.

Chief Minister Mohan Yadav has announced an ex-gratia of ₹4 lakh for the families of the deceased.

Bargi Dam, located about 40 km from Jabalpur, is a popular tourist destination, making the incident all the more alarming.

#Jabalpur #BargiDam #BoatTragedy #BreakingNews #MadhyaPradesh

articles.title: 6 Killed, Including 2 Children, as Car Crashes into Lorry on Hyderabad ORR
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a devastating road accident, six people, including two minors, lost their lives after a car rammed into a stationary lorry on the Shamshabad Outer Ring Road near Exit 16 on Friday, May 1. According to reports, seven People were travelling in the car when the accident occurred.

body.html:
In a devastating road accident, six people, including two minors, lost their lives after a car rammed into a stationary lorry on the Shamshabad Outer Ring Road near Exit 16 on Friday, May 1.

According to reports, seven People were travelling in the car when the accident occurred. The vehicle, driven by Bolli Shiva Kumar (37), a native of Rajanna Sircilla district residing in Sanathnagar, crashed into the lorry from behind. The impact was so severe that the car got wedged under the truck, completely crushing its front portion.

Among the deceased are Shiva Kumar, his wife Bolli Lasya, and Bolli Rishitha. Other victims have been identified as Kodem Srinivas (40), his wife Swetha (35), and two minors—Krishna Chandra and Kodem Madhav.

Swetha is the sole survivor and has been admitted to a hospital, where she is undergoing treatment.

Police said the group was returning after darshan at the Yadagirigutta temple when the accident took place.

Authorities have initiated an investigation into the incident.

#Hyderabad #RoadAccident #BreakingNews #ORR #Shamshabad

articles.title: Haridwar Ghat Row: Woman Bathes Pet Dog in Ganga, Sparks Heated Clash with Devotees
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dispute broke out at a Ganga ghat in Haridwar, Uttarakhand, after a woman was seen bathing her pet dog in the river, triggering objections from devotees present at the site. The incident reportedly took place at Sarvanand Ghat, where the woman had arrived with her family.

body.html:
A dispute broke out at a Ganga ghat in Haridwar, Uttarakhand, after a woman was seen bathing her pet dog in the river, triggering objections from devotees present at the site.

The incident reportedly took place at Sarvanand Ghat, where the woman had arrived with her family. Witnesses said she entered the river with her dog while several people were taking a holy dip, leading to strong objections over religious sentiments associated with the Ganga.

According to reports, the situation quickly escalated into a heated argument between the woman and bystanders. She allegedly reacted angrily, shouted at those questioning her actions, and made remarks asserting her influence during the confrontation.

As tensions rose, family members intervened and eventually persuaded her to leave the spot along with the dog.

The entire episode was captured on video by a bystander and has since gone viral on social media, sparking widespread debate and mixed reactions online.

Local priest Ujjwal Pandit also criticised the act, stating that the Ganga holds deep religious significance and is central to Hindu rituals. He termed the incident a reflection of lack of awareness regarding religious practices.

Authorities have not yet issued an official statement on the matter.

#Haridwar #Ganga #Controversy #BreakingNews #ViralVideo

articles.title: Bengaluru Road Rage Horror: Couple Attacked by 15 Men in Daylight After Warning Bikers
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking road rage incident was reported on Saturday from Bettadasanapura near Electronics City in Bengaluru, where a couple from West Bengal was allegedly assaulted by a group of miscreants in broad daylight.

body.html:
A shocking road rage incident was reported on Saturday from Bettadasanapura near Electronics City in Bengaluru, where a couple from West Bengal was allegedly assaulted by a group of miscreants in broad daylight.

According to police, the victims—Soumyadeep Sen and Vyundreela Pradhan—were travelling in their Tata Altroz (KA 51 MR 0491) from Bettadasanapura towards Electronics City when the incident occurred.

The altercation reportedly began after the couple advised a group of youths, who were performing dangerous wheeling on the road, to ride carefully. The warning allegedly triggered the attack.

Police said the miscreants intercepted the couple’s car, smashed its window, and physically assaulted them. The situation escalated when more individuals gathered at the spot, with around 10 to 15 people allegedly involved in the attack.

The entire incident was captured on the car’s dashboard camera, and the video has since gone viral, raising serious concerns about road safety and law enforcement.

Recounting the incident, Vyundreela Pradhan stated that after being advised to drive safely, the bikers stopped their vehicle and began arguing. Soon, more people joined and started assaulting her husband. When she intervened, she was also attacked and pushed.

Both victims sustained injuries and were later admitted to a private hospital for treatment.

The case falls under the jurisdiction of Electronics City Police Station. Police have launched a search operation to identify and arrest the accused. Further investigation is underway.

#Bengaluru #RoadRage #BreakingNews #ViralVideo #CrimeNews

articles.title: Noida Rage: Resident Rams Gate, Assaults Guard Over Delay—Arrested After Viral Video
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An incident of alleged assault and reckless behaviour was reported on May 1, 2026, at Rajat Vihar Society in Sector 62, Noida, where a resident rammed his vehicle into a gate barrier and attacked a security guard following a brief delay in entry.

body.html:
An incident of alleged assault and reckless behaviour was reported on May 1, 2026, at Rajat Vihar Society in Sector 62, Noida, where a resident rammed his vehicle into a gate barrier and attacked a security guard following a brief delay in entry.

The accused has been identified as Daksh Priyansh. According to reports, the altercation began when the security guard briefly stopped his vehicle at the society gate. The situation quickly escalated into a heated confrontation, during which the accused allegedly rammed the barrier and assaulted the guard.

The entire episode was captured on video and later went viral on social media, drawing widespread criticism. The footage has triggered discussions around alleged entitlement and the mistreatment of frontline workers, including security guards and service staff.

Noida Police confirmed that the accused was arrested shortly after the incident. The Deputy Commissioner of Police stated that legal proceedings have been initiated and further action is underway.
